psalm-31-1.verse: In You, O Lord, I have taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed; In Your righteousness deliver me.
psalm-31-1.prayer: Lord, I take refuge in You. Help me trust in Your righteousness and deliverance when challenges arise.

psalm-31-2.verse: Incline Your ear to me, rescue me quickly; Be to me a rock of strength, A stronghold to save me.
psalm-31-2.prayer: Father, incline Your ear to my prayers. Be my rock of strength and my safe place in times of need.

psalm-31-3.verse: For You are my rock and my fortress; For Your name’s sake You will lead me and guide me.
psalm-31-3.prayer: Lord, You are my fortress and my guide. Lead me according to Your wisdom and help me follow Your direction faithfully.

psalm-31-4.verse: You will pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You are my strength.
psalm-31-4.prayer: Father, rescue me from traps, temptations, and anything that seeks to draw me away from Your will.

psalm-31-5.verse: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have ransomed me, O Lord, God of truth.
psalm-31-5.prayer: Lord, I place my life into Your hands. Thank You for Your faithfulness and for redeeming me through Your love.

psalm-31-6.verse: I hate those who regard vain idols, But I trust in the Lord.
psalm-31-6.prayer: Father, keep my heart devoted to You alone. Help me reject anything that competes with my trust in You.

psalm-31-7.verse: I will rejoice and be glad in Your lovingkindness, Because You have seen my affliction; You have known the troubles of my soul,
psalm-31-7.prayer: Lord, thank You for Your lovingkindness and mercy. You see my struggles and care deeply about every concern I bring to You.

psalm-31-8.verse: And You have not given me over into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a large place.
psalm-31-8.prayer: Father, thank You for setting me in a place of freedom. Help me walk confidently in the liberty You provide.

psalm-31-9.verse: Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I am in distress; My eye is wasted away from grief, my soul and my body also.
psalm-31-9.prayer: Lord, have mercy on me when I am distressed. Strengthen me when I feel weary and overwhelmed.

psalm-31-10.verse: For my life is spent with sorrow And my years with sighing; My strength has failed because of my iniquity, And my body has wasted away.
psalm-31-10.prayer: Father, when sorrow or difficulty weighs upon me, renew my strength and remind me of Your sustaining grace.

psalm-31-11.verse: Because of all my adversaries, I have become a reproach, Especially to my neighbors, And an object of dread to my acquaintances; Those who see me in the street flee from me.
psalm-31-11.prayer: Lord, when I feel rejected or misunderstood, help me remember that my identity is secure in You.

psalm-31-12.verse: I am forgotten as a dead man, out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.
psalm-31-12.prayer: Father, even when I feel forgotten by others, remind me that I am never forgotten by You.

psalm-31-13.verse: For I have heard the slander of many, Terror is on every side; While they took counsel together against me, They schemed to take away my life.
psalm-31-13.prayer: Lord, protect me from fear and anxiety. Help me trust You when circumstances seem threatening or uncertain.

psalm-31-14.verse: But as for me, I trust in You, O Lord, I say, “You are my God.”
psalm-31-14.prayer: Father, I place my trust in You. Strengthen my faith and help me depend on Your promises.

psalm-31-15.verse: My times are in Your hand; Deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from those who persecute me.
psalm-31-15.prayer: Lord, my times are in Your hands. Help me trust Your timing, Your plans, and Your purposes for my life.

psalm-31-16.verse: Make Your face to shine upon Your servant; Save me in Your lovingkindness.
psalm-31-16.prayer: Father, let Your face shine upon me and fill me with the assurance of Your love and favor.

psalm-31-17.verse: Let me not be put to shame, O Lord, for I call upon You; Let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent in Sheol.
psalm-31-17.prayer: Lord, help me call upon You with confidence, knowing that You hear and answer according to Your perfect will.

psalm-31-18.verse: Let the lying lips be mute, Which speak arrogantly against the righteous With pride and contempt.
psalm-31-18.prayer: Father, establish truth and righteousness. Guard me from deception and help me speak with integrity.

psalm-31-19.verse: How great is Your goodness, Which You have stored up for those who fear You, Which You have wrought for those who take refuge in You, Before the sons of men!
psalm-31-19.prayer: Lord, thank You for the abundance of Your goodness stored up for those who trust in You.

psalm-31-20.verse: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the conspiracies of man; You keep them secretly in a shelter from the strife of tongues.
psalm-31-20.prayer: Father, hide me in the shelter of Your presence. Protect me from discouragement, fear, and harmful influences.

psalm-31-21.verse: Blessed be the Lord, For He has made marvelous His lovingkindness to me in a besieged city.
psalm-31-21.prayer: Lord, thank You for Your wonderful lovingkindness and for showing Your faithfulness throughout my life.

psalm-31-22.verse: As for me, I said in my alarm, “I am cut off from before Your eyes”; Nevertheless You heard the voice of my supplications When I cried to You.
psalm-31-22.prayer: Father, when I feel abandoned or afraid, remind me that You hear every prayer and never leave me alone.

psalm-31-23.verse: O love the Lord, all you His godly ones! The Lord preserves the faithful And fully recompenses the proud doer.
psalm-31-23.prayer: Lord, help me love You wholeheartedly and remain faithful to You in every season of life.

psalm-31-24.verse: Be strong and let your heart take courage, All you who hope in the Lord.
psalm-31-24.prayer: Father, strengthen my heart as I wait for You. Fill me with courage, hope, and confidence in Your promises.

psalm-31-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for being my refuge, my fortress, and my faithful protector. When fear, sorrow, or uncertainty come, help me place my trust fully in You. Strengthen my heart, guide my steps, and remind me that my life is safely in Your hands. Fill me with courage, peace, and hope as I continue to follow You. May I rest securely in Your love and faithfulness every day.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
